newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures end higher on yen's fall.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures end higher on yen's fall.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended higher on Wednesday as short-covering emerged following the yen's decline against the dollar and on reports that Japan's rubber stocks had declined, traders said.
Prices ranged from 1.6 yen to 3.3 yen per kg higher. Benchmark April was 2.9 yen higher at 144.0 yen.

Rubber futures extended their gains in the afternoon in reaction to a report that quoted an industry body as saying that rubber stocks totalled 47,182 tonnes at the end of October, down by 338 tonnes from October 20. "Benchmark April will test 145 yen soon," one trader said.--Tokyo Commodity Desk
